Specification: This module specifies an atomic commitment protocol with one coordinator and a set of participants, using a simple broadcast mechanism in an asynchronous setting. The comments explain that synchronous communication has been replaced by implicit asynchronous communication and that failures are detected magically rather than via timeouts; because broadcast is modeled as a sequence of individual sends that can be interrupted by failure, the protocol is non-terminating and the usual termination property AC5 does not hold. The specification defines typed initial states, participant and coordinator actions, a next-state relation with weak fairness on non-death progress actions, and then states safety, liveness, stronger auxiliary properties, and explicitly invalid properties for the protocol.

[request : [participants -> BOOLEAN], vote : [participants -> {waiting, yes, no}], broadcast : [participants -> {commit, abort, notsent}], decision : {commit, abort, undecided}, alive : BOOLEAN, faulty : BOOLEAN]
AlwaysOp:
[] \A i, j \in participants : 
          \/ participant[i].decision # commit 
          \/ participant[j].decision # abort

[] (  (\E i \in participants : participant[i].decision = commit) 
          => (\A j \in participants : participant[j].vote = yes))

[] (  (\E i \in participants : participant[i].decision = abort) 
            => \/ (\E j \in participants : participant[j].vote = no)
               \/ (\E j \in participants : participant[j].faulty)
               \/ coordinator.faulty)

[] /\ (\A i \in participants : participant[i].decision = commit 
                                => [](participant[i].decision = commit))
          /\ (\A j \in participants : participant[j].decision = abort  
                                => [](participant[j].decision = abort))

[] (  (\E i \in participants : participant[i].decision = commit) 
                  => /\ (\A j \in participants : participant[j].vote = yes)
                     /\ coordinator.decision = commit)

[] (  (\E i \in participants : participant[i].decision = abort) 
                    => \/ (\E j \in participants : participant[j].vote = no)
                       \/ /\ \E j \in participants : participant[j].faulty
                          /\ coordinator.decision = abort
                       \/ /\ coordinator.faulty
                          /\ coordinator.decision = undecided)

[] (  (\E i \in participants : participant[i].decision = abort) 
                  => (\E j \in participants : participant[j].vote = no))
EventuallyOp:
<> \/ \A i \in participants : participant[i].decision \in {abort, commit}
            \/ \E j \in participants : participant[j].faulty
            \/ coordinator.faulty
LeadsToOp:
(\A i \in participants : participant[i].alive)
                          ~> (\A k \in participants : participant[k].decision # undecided)
